assembly_info.comments:
The annotation was added by the NCBI Prokaryotic Genome Annotation Pipeline (PGAP). Information about PGAP can be found here: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genome/annotation_prok/
This version of the assembly represents 38.2X coverage of the genome
This version of the assembly represents 38.2X coverage of the genome. A single contig was split into two, ABQK01000001 and ABQK01000005. Consequently, the first and last contigs are contiguous. This split was to preserve the genome coordinates relative to the Bacillus reference sequence in GenBank AL009126.
